covered.title: ChatGPT now answers with buttons, charts and mini apps
covered.hook: Did you know ChatGPT can now answer you with buttons, charts, and little apps it builds on the spot? It's called Intelligent UI, and it arrived with GPT-6.

covered.title: A startup raised $50M for a cap that turns thoughts into text
covered.hook: Did you know a startup wants you to talk to AI just by thinking, in a baseball cap? It's called Sabi, and investors just bet fifty million dollars on it.
